Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Dustin Cote <dusti...@home.com> wrote:
> Are there any differences between the "same" card released in Sabbat
> as their is in Sabbat War?

The WotC reprint of Sabbat didn't change any of the texts from
the original printing of Sabbat, no.

The original version of Sabbat did include reprints that were
changed from their previous base-set incarnations, either
superficially or functionally.

This is all a shock to me. I reread your answer after I posted my
response and realized you referred to a "WotC reprint of Sabbat" (though
I didn't likewise notice Justin's question wasn't exactly what I thought
it was, too). I didn't recall there was a ever a second WotC printing
of The Sabbat - unless you're talking about a second scheduled "print
run" of the same expansion, which is what this sounds like. By a "print
run", I mean something that's printed at separate times, possibly at
separate locations that results in multiple spurts of supply becoming
available at different time. I recall WotC doing this more than once with
Magic expansion. The main distinction is that the whole thing was planned
ahead of time and was not a reaction to sudden, unexpected sell-out.

Was this the case or was the second printing in response to an early sell-out
of the first printing - just as with Sabbat War?

I should still rant more. Not that it's likely to accomplish anything but
a guy's gotta keep in practice.

Fred

> a second scheduled "print run" of the same expansion, which is what

One year after Sabbat was released, WOTC reprinted it and re-released
it, once again on Halloween. This was one of our major problems with
Ryan Dancey, formerly in charge of VTES at WOTC, who claimed that the
game didn't sell well enough to warrant another expansion.

Sabbat sold well enough that they decided to reprint one year after
it was first released. Nothing was modified or changed at that time.

Carpe Noctem.

Messages.Author: Dustin Cote
Messages.Body:
heheheh! Wow, people are talking about me in the 3rd person.
First off...it's Dustin, not Justin.
(But that's ok, since the last name is more important I guess.)

Well, I reread my question (Just to make sure I wasn't confused, heh)
and will reiterate....

What I was originally asking was, is there a difference between card
XXX in "Sabbat" and the card XXX in "Sabbat War".
That has been easily answered (thanks) due to the symbols being
different. "S" versus "squigly cross thing" (love that description!)

The reason I asked this is because due to "Sabbat" prices, I figure
that by getting the full "Sabbat War" collection would then narrow
down which "Sabbat" cards I'd have to get, to get a "full set". A full
set meaning simply one of each card...from whichever set. (usually I
settle for nothing less than one of every possible card, no matter how
small the difference, but i may just have to live with one of
each--any set...so that I can study all the cards atleast)

I don't know about you guys/gals...but I went to the VTES web site,
and took a copy of "Sabbat" list, and then a copy of "Sabbat War" list
and then merged them together, showing which cards were "Sabbat-only",
"Sabbat-War-only" , and "Sabbat & Sabbat War" cards.

I can now, at a glance see which cards were in both sets, which ones
were "Sabbat" only, and which ones were "Sabbat War" only.

Ok...so now that I clarified my original question, I have to expand it
due to everyone's input.. Looks to me that there was more than one
printing of "Sabbat" !!

So here it is:

1. Are there ANY individual card differences in the 1st printing of
"Sabbat" vs. the 2nd printing of "Sabbat" ?

Already Answered:
2. Are there any differences between "Sabbat" cards and "Sabbat War"
cards (if they were the same card) ---ALREADY ANSWERED

3. Is there ANY difference between the 1st printing of "Sabbat War"
vs. the 2nd printing of "Sabbat War". Answer so far is YES. I've seen
3 examples for text errata, and one vague description of a yellow
plate being reversed (what does that mean? Are there other picture
related changes?)

So, is there any way we can get a list of what is different?
(Collectors would like to know:)

One thing I'd like to mention...I understand that differences between
"First printing and 2nd printing" can blur, and disappear... For
instance, the original Jyhad set...we don't talk about there being 3
print runs (or more) but we agree that there were 3 different Tasha
Morgans, and 2 different Renegade Garous, (if my memory holds true).
These are exactly the type of differences I'm interested in for
"Sabbat" and "Sabbat War".

Thank you VERY much.

Dustin



Messages.Body:
Dustin Cote <dusti...@home.com> wrote:
> 1. Are there ANY individual card differences in the 1st printing of
> "Sabbat" vs. the 2nd printing of "Sabbat" ?

None known, no.

> Already Answered:
> 2. Are there any differences between "Sabbat" cards and "Sabbat War"
> cards (if they were the same card) ---ALREADY ANSWERED

Yes.

> 3. Is there ANY difference between the 1st printing of "Sabbat War"
> vs. the 2nd printing of "Sabbat War". Answer so far is YES. I've seen
> 3 examples for text errata, and one vague description of a yellow
> plate being reversed (what does that mean? Are there other picture
> related changes?)

No other art changes of which I'm aware, no.

> So, is there any way we can get a list of what is different?
> (Collectors would like to know:)

Sure. One should appear on the web site RealSoonNow(tm).

> One thing I'd like to mention...I understand that differences between
> "First printing and 2nd printing" can blur, and disappear... For
> instance, the original Jyhad set...we don't talk about there being 3
> print runs (or more) but we agree that there were 3 different Tasha
> Morgans, and 2 different Renegade Garous, (if my memory holds true).

Only two Tasha's with Jyhad backs. And this is not a function of
the number of print runs (I believe Jyhad had only one print run,
albeit a very large one) - it's a factor of the card appearing
twice on the Rare sheet, with differences between the two instances.

> These are exactly the type of differences I'm interested in for
> "Sabbat" and "Sabbat War".

Ah. Then you'll also be interesting in knowing changes in
Artists citations ("Max Fellwalker" vs. "Max Shade Fellwalker"
on Angela Decker, for instance). I'm afraid the White Wolf
list won't be listing all of those.

Also, all of the cards were laid out anew for the Sabbat War
printing, so fonts and icons (and icon order on vampires)
have almost all changed from the WotC Sabbat runs to the
White Wolf Sabbat War runs.

Besides the difference in the S and squigly cross thing, don't forget the
